title: Sentence-Aware AI Overview & 40% Smaller APK
message: GabAI v0.3.2 introduces full Sentence-Aware reading context, interactive vertical related questions, zero-AI visual context, and a 40% reduced APK size.
changelog:
• Sentence-Aware Context: Highlights target words within enclosing OCR sentences
• Vertical Related Questions: Accordion questions with on-demand answers
• Zero-AI Visual Context: 100% deterministic diagram search with zero token latency
• 40% Smaller APK: Stripped unused architectures and crypto tables (32 MB vs 55 MB)
